title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode4 How to Sparkle

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Are you hungry, Airi? Food's ready.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
That audition...
You helped me prepare for it so much, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
You don't have to apologize.
I know that you did your absolute best, dear.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: The judges even praised you for trying so hard, remember?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: But... But that isn't good enough!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Because I wanna become a dazzling idol!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Being praised for trying hard won't make me happy! I have to blow them away with my aura...!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: I see... Then, you'll need to eat up and try again.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: I mean, you're going to have to practice quite a lot if you want to dazzle people as an idol, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: So first, you need to eat properly.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Alright, time to start over from scratch!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (My next audition is all lined up, so I've gotta do everything I can to pass!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Starting by reviewing the dance routine Mom helped me fix.)

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: It's impossible for a monster like you to ever become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: You guys are always pestering me like this... Guess you've got nothing better to do!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line:
Huh? We do too.
We're on our way to baseball practice.

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
Let's go.
We don't want her to beat us up before that tournament.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I can too become an idol...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (It's not going to be easy, but it's not impossible...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (No matter how hard a dance is, do it with a dazzling smile!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I have to think about everybody who's watching me, and accomplish something other than just trying hard.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Do, mi, so, do, so, mi, do.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: No... Every time I go for a high note, I end up sounding a little funny...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I have to figure out a way to hit those high notes while still sounding cute!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Relax your throat and try again...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (This is really hard... But I'm so close to the end...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I've gotta sprint to the finish line!!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why'd we have to play against the Gowan Yankees in the first round?

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully B
rows.Line:
They're always winning tournaments, right?
We never stood a chance...

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line:
I heard she failed her last audition.
But she still hasn't given up...

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: I'm gonna go back and practice.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I still have some time left until the audition.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(I have to keep doing everything I can!
And then...)
